name: Fandral's Message
summary: In Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm sends a message across the sea to Onu in Darkshore. The sealed dispatch carries news about Oracle Glade in Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Dispatch from the Archdruid
sections.body: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm writes from the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. His sealed dispatch is addressed to Onu, the Ancient of Lore who dwells in the Grove of the Ancients. Reports have reached Fandral about the state of Oracle Glade in Teldrassil, and he sends a courier south of Auberdine with word for Onu. The journey crosses the waters to Darkshore, carrying a message from the heart of the new World Tree to Kalimdor’s older, shadowed mainland.

sections.title: Contrasting Tempos
sections.body: Onu remarks that Fandral is always in a hurry. The Ancient of Lore says affairs should unfold at nature’s own pace, as the ancients believe. To the slow-living treants of Darkshore, Fandral’s haste differs sharply from the patient wisdom once shown by Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage.

faq.answer: Fandral’s Message is a sealed dispatch from Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm to Onu, the Ancient of Lore in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

faq.q: Who sends this message and why?
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm writes from Darnassus after receiving reports about Oracle Glade in Teldrassil. He sends word to Onu in Darkshore.

faq.q: Where does this message need to go?
faq.answer: Carry the message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, directly south of Auberdine.

faq.q: What does Onu think of the letter?
faq.answer: Onu says Fandral is always in a hurry. The Ancient observes that nature moves at its own pace, a truth Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage understood better.

angles.text: As a druid, carrying a message between the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus and the Ancients of Lore in Darkshore shows the divide between Fandral Staghelm’s drive and the older guardians’ patience.
As a night elf, this dispatch takes you from the crown of Teldrassil toward the ancestral forests of Kalimdor’s mainland.
